platform.description: Post-rebrand Windows-checkout source contracts, rolled forward for FULLSCREEN-SESSION-01 after the issue #123 paste-path, issue #131 scrollback-content, issue #133 named-layout and PKG-44 forward-compatibility reviews. Schema v1 adds the fullscreen state and optional fullscreen_maximized return flag; older tolerant readers restore unknown states as normal and skip unknown fields. The parser retains strict node kinds and axes, .allocate = .alloc_always ownership, opaque-JSON named-layout placement stripping, bounded scrollback and load-time pane-text rejection (InvalidPaneText). Hashes reflect checkout normalization. The durable git_commit identifies the original baseline base; Contracts.99-Baselines.ps1 independently pins the reviewed session-schema digest so squash-merging and deleting the PR branch cannot disable fail-closed artifact verification.
